project_name: Beacon Data Centers Westline Site / Foster Park data center
status_detail: Irion County Commissioners Court posted a June 2, 2026 agenda item to gather information on data center development. Local reporting describes Beacon Data Centers / Westline TX Holdings pursuing a proposed site near Foster Park/Spring Creek in the Tom Green-Irion area; exact county boundary needs parcel verification.

Included for follow-up because local/social sources also describe an Irion County Foster Park permit request.

status_detail: TDLR registered Data Center THM1A on May 27, 2025 with start date June 18, 2025, completion April 16, 2027, 280,000 sq ft, and $350M estimated cost.
